CO01.en: GREEN BERET: We have to take out the heavy artillery!
CO01.zh: 绿贝雷：我们必须摧毁重型火炮！

CH01.en: ALLIED SOLDIER: I agree sir, but we´ve lost so many men!
CH01.zh: 盟军士兵：我同意，长官，可我们损失了太多人！

CO02.en: GREEN BERET: We have to push now soldier. Remember, this is what I do best. Let's go kick some Nazi arse.
CO02.zh: 绿贝雷：士兵，我们现在必须推进。记住，这是我最擅长的。走，去揍那帮纳粹杂种。

OR01.en: Penetrate the enemy beach defenses and then eliminate the engineers that operate the artillery. You must eliminate all of the enemies inside the bunkers located to the East and West.
OR01.zh: 突破敌人海滩防线，然后消灭操作火炮的工兵。你必须消灭东西两侧碉堡内的所有敌人。

TIP1.en: Doors: You may find locked doors that can only be opened from inside.
TIP1.zh: 门：有些锁住的门只能从里面打开。

TIP2.en: Now, your troops can access the bunker complex through the door.
TIP2.zh: 现在你的部队可以通过这扇门进入碉堡群。
